_readme: Drop a new option folder (with spec.json + model) inside its category folder, then add the folder name to that category's options list below. Nothing in index.html / main.css / main.js needs to change.

instructor.text: Welcome to Experiment 06 — Flight Performance Envelope. There is no new bench testing here: the thrust, current and efficiency you measured in Experiment 01 are inherited, and this lab turns them into drone-level performance — thrust-to-weight, hover throttle, control margin and payload capacity.

Start in Input Parameters — tap any component tile to pick a chassis, motor, prop and battery. Every number in the Calculations strip and every chart updates live from those choices; watch the Diagnostics Log for collisions or over-rated parts.

Tab 1 · Hover & Control Margin is a real flight. Use the throttle slider to lift the drone off the pad from the ground and hold a steady hover. Watch the TWR traffic-light halo and the live hover throttle and control-margin readouts as you fly.

Toggle Forward Flight 30° while hovering: only cos(30°) of your thrust now holds altitude, so the drone tips forward, translates across the chamber and the control margin drops — add throttle to hold height. This is the cosine-loss lesson.

Tab 2 · Payload Envelope loads cargo up to 2 kg. Run it to sweep the load and find where thrust-to-weight falls through 1.5 (the practical safe limit) and 1.0 (the absolute lift-off limit). Complete both tabs to unlock your reward component.
